A new version of the archon is available on the  download page : 1.5g
The previous version (1.5f) did not have the correct content and should not be used.

The archons must be used either with Excel or LibreOffice (not OpenOffice).

I have also uploaded a small program that allows you to test seatings (requires Windows): www.vekn.net/images/stories/downloads/ArchonRuleChecker.zip
